alert.low: {tank} is running low: {level} L left ({pct} % of {capacity} L), {days}. Mix a new batch before it runs dry.
alert.low_estimated: {tank} is running low: {level} L left ({pct} % of {capacity} L), {days}. Estimated from the pH Down valve open time (the acid line is not metered). Mix a new batch before it runs dry.
alert.empty: {tank} is almost empty: {level} L left ({pct} % of {capacity} L), {days}. Refill it now — once it runs dry nothing is dosed from it.
alert.empty_estimated: {tank} is almost empty: {level} L left ({pct} % of {capacity} L), {days}. Estimated from the pH Down valve open time (the acid line is not metered). Refill it now — once it runs dry nothing is dosed from it.
